A 4-Star Castle Hotel & Golf Resort on a Private Island
Welcome to Waterford Castle Resort
Waterford Castle Hotel & Golf Resort is set on an enchanted 310-acre Private Island, accessible via a short crossing on the resort's private car ferry over the King’s Channel .
A jewel in Ireland's Ancient East, the Island Resort offers the very best of Irish hospitality. Our historic 16th Century luxury Castle hotel combines the gracious living of an elegant past with every modern comfort and convenience. With just nineteen bedrooms, Waterford Castle is the ideal place for an intimate getaway, or to take over exclusively for a special celebration.
In addition to the Castle hotel, the Island Resort offers 45 three and four bedroom self-catering lodges . The Island lodges are ideal for golfing parties, groups and families.
Our award-winning Munster Room Restaurant holds 2-AA Rosettes. Under the direction of the Resort’s Head Chef, the award winning culinary team create truly memorable fine dining and informal dining experiences. The restaurants original oak-panelled walls, ornate ceilings and Waterford Crystal chandeliers create an atmospheric backdrop to an exquisite dining experience. Relax and enjoy an aperitif in our Fitzgerald Bar , which houses the finest Irish whiskey collection and comprehensive wine cellar.

Castle Rooms & Suites
Our luxury 16th Century Castle is Ireland's only Island Castle hotel, make it one of the most iconic Irish Castles. Find yourself transported to a different world with each of our beautifully appointed guestrooms; each one offering gracious style combined with all the modern comforts you might expect of a world class hotel establishment. Guests of Waterford Castle can also enjoy indulgent amenities such as a Nespresso machine, bathrobes and optional evening turndown service.

Frequently Asked Questions
Does Waterford Castle have walk in showers? Are there baths in the rooms?
Yes, the bedrooms in Waterford Castle have either a walk-in shower or free standing bath. If you have a preference for either, please ensure you contact Reception prior to booking to ensure availability.
How many rooms are there in Waterford Castle hotel?
The Castle has 19 bedrooms.
What is the best room at Waterford Castle?
All our bedrooms are individually designed and feature opulent decor. Our best room available is our magnificent Presidential Suite.
What types of room are available at Waterford Castle hotel?
We have a selection of rooms, including a double or twin Classic Room, a double or twin Deluxe Room, a Deluxe Suite and our Presidential Suite. We also have self catering options in our Island Lodges.
How much is a hotel room at Waterford Castle?
Our rooms vary in price depending on the room type and time of year. A one night stay including complimentary breakfast is from around €190 up to €430.
Do you have any family or interconnecting rooms at Waterford Castle hotel?
Due to the historic nature of the building we do not have any family or interconnecting rooms. We can provide travel cots or sofa/rollaway beds in some of our Deluxe Rooms and Suites, please contact us prior to booking and we can advise on cost and availability. We recommend guests travelling with children to consider our 3 bedroom self catering Lodges which provide a more spacious and comfortable option.
What is the difference between rooms at Waterford Castle hotel?
Our Classic room is our most standard offering, with amenities such as a Nespresso coffee machine, kettle, TV, bed, desk, chair and ensuite. Our Deluxe Rooms have the same offerings as our Classic rooms however they are much larger. Our Deluxe Suites have a separate living room in addition to the bedroom and ensuite bathroom. Our Presidential Suite is our largest and most luxurious room.
Is Waterford Castle hotel dog friendly?
While we do not allow dogs in our Castle hotel, they can stay in our self catering Lodges .
Is there free parking at Waterford Castle hotel?
Yes, our hotel offers free parking on the Resort.

Self Catering Lodges in Waterford
Lodges
The Island Resort offers 45 family friendly modern, Self-Catering Lodges in Waterford, Ireland. Each Lodge sleeps six people with three double bedrooms.
Our lodges offer open plan living:
kitchen-dining
living room with satellite TV
laundry facilities
3 bedrooms
4 bathrooms
outdoor dining and picnic areas
Private veranda which overlooks the 18-hole golf course , gardens and wildlife, including our resident deer!
Complimentary WiFi throughout the lodge
DVD player rental with selection of DVDs
The Self-Catering Lodges are the perfect location for families, golf trips , corporate gatherings or even a ladies destination with afternoon tea available during your stay (subject to availability). The lodges are a very comfortable vacation home in Waterford for a family of six, each room offering double beds and a pull out couch for little ones to avail of.
Our Lodge guests can avail of all the Island has to offer, including Castle dining, or the bistro style menu and takeaway options at the King’s Channel Clubhouse .
Waterford Castle is among the best hotels with self catering Ireland has to offer, with a wide variety of things to see and do right on your doorstep, including the Waterford Greenway, House of Waterford Crystal and UNESCO Copper Coast.
Waterford Castle Resort Activities
This unique Island Resort offers activities for all the family, including:
Tennis/Basketball courts
18-hole championship Golf Course
Driving Range
Clay pigeon shooting (*pre-booking required)
Nature walks
Playground
Resort Dining
Residents of the Island can choose from a variety of dining options, from treating themselves to an afternoon of our Castle Afternoon Tea, a memorable fine-dining evening experience in the luxurious Munster Room Restaurant or tucking into our bistro style menu from our Kings Channel Clubhouse . Sample menus can be viewed here . Opening times vary seasonally, we always recommend you book in advance to ensure availability during your stay.
We also welcome residents to dine at our sister property, One the Waterfront . This stunning beachside venue offers a spacious cliffside terrace and panoramic sea views in Tramore, just 20 minutes drive away. For more information call One the Waterfront direct on 051 271 350.
Nearby Attractions in Waterford
The Island Resort is surrounded by a host of attractions and activities in Waterford and surrounding areas in Ireland's Ancient East. Situated close to Waterford City Centre, the resort is a world away yet centrally located. Below is just a small selection of things to do nearby:
House of Waterford Crystal
Waterford Museum of Treasures - Bishops Palace, Medieval Museum and Reginald's Tower Viking Museum
King of the Vikings virtual reality experience
Mount Congreve Gardens
Lafcadio Hearn Japanese Gardens
Waterford Greenway
Tramore Blue Flag beach
UNESCO Copper Coast Scenic Drive
Day Trips
In addition to the plethora of local attractions, Waterford Castle Resort is also an ideal base for full or half day trips to nearby counties. Historic Kilkenny town is just an hours drive North and is well-known for it's versatile attractions including the Kilkenny Castle and Gardens and Medieval Mile Museum. To the East, Wexford is home to exciting features such as Hook Lighthouse, the oldest working lighthouse in the world, and Loftus Hall, one of Ireland's most infamous haunted houses. To the West, Cork is full of colourful towns such as Cobh and scenic areas.
Lodge Booking & Cancellation Policy
For Lodge stays of up to 4 nights , full payment is due on arrival at the Resort, and free cancellation is available up until 72 hours prior to arrival. Cancellation within 72 hours will result in a charge equal to the first nights stay.
For Lodge stays of 5 nights or more, 20% non-refundable deposit is required at time of booking, with the remaining balance payable on arrival at the Resort. Cancellation up to 72 hours prior to arrival will result in the loss of the deposit, and cancellation within 72 hours of arrival will incur loss of deposit plus a charge equal to the first nights stay.
Group / Multiple Lodge Bookings
For group reservations (3 or more Lodges) a 20% non-refundable deposit is required at time of booking, with the remaining balance payable on arrival at the Resort. Cancellation up to 72 hours prior to arrival will result in the loss of the deposit, and cancellation within 72 hours of arrival will incur loss of deposit plus a charge equal to the first nights stay. To make a Lodge group enquiry please contact our team on 051 878 203 or send us an email.
Frequently Asked Questions
I’m staying in the lodges, where do I check-in?
Check-in and check-out is at the main Waterford Castle hotel reception unless otherwise directed by staff prior to arrival.
I’m staying in the lodges, can I visit the Castle?
Guests of the lodges may visit the Castle, including for dining , once there are no private events being held. If visiting the Castle is essential for you, we recommend you book a room in the Castle hotel itself to avoid disappointment.
I’m staying in the lodges, can I have breakfast at the Castle?
Guests of the self catering lodges may avail of breakfast in the Castle at an added cost, subject to availability. Please contact reception prior to booking.
I’m staying in the lodges, do I need to bring towels?
No, the Lodges are fully equipped and towels are provided. Additional linen and towels are available if required, at an additional charge.
Are the self catering Lodges wheelchair friendly?

About Us
About Us
Waterford Castle Hotel & Golf Resort is a unique Island venue situated in Ireland's Ancient East.
The Resort consists of:
- 19 bedroom luxury 4 star Castle hotel
- 45 modern self-catering lodges
- 18-hole par 72 golf course
All set on a tranquil 310-acre private island that is accessible only by exclusive resort car ferry. The Resort is an Island getaway that's not so far away - centrally located just 10 minutes drive from Waterford City.
The Island Resort is truly unique, being the only one of its kind in Ireland. The 310-acre Island is home to a variety of Irish flora and fauna including red squirrels, foxes, badgers and our herd of wild Sika deer.
The Island Resort is owned by local businessman Seamus Walsh since 2016, who has since refurbished many aspects of the property, with more plans for the future. Mr Walsh is also the owner of One the Waterfront , a modern and vibrant seaside venue in nearby Tramore.
The Waterford Castle Hotel is available for private events and bookings such as weddings.
For information on the historic nature of the property please visit here .
For inquiries and bookings, please contact us on 353 (0) 51 878 203 or email info@waterfordcastleresort.com
